changelog:
course-video-studio v0.1.1

- Initial release of the skill to generate talking-head lesson videos from finished lecture scripts and an authorized teacher portrait.
- Covers complete workflow: asset inspection, voice selection or cloning with explicit consent, TTS and video synthesis routing, live balance/payment steps, and robust task/billing/recovery guidance.
- Includes clear path to handle pronunciation, input requirements, and verification steps.
- Directs users to bundled scripts and documentation for installation, authentication, task recovery, and troubleshooting.
- Focuses on consent, correctness, and avoiding accidental charges or unauthorized likeness use.
summary: Turn lecture scripts and one authorized teacher portrait into talking-head lesson videos. This AI course video studio and digital teacher studio prepares lecture narration, then produces a stable presenter clip for each lesson so a training team can publish without a camera shoot. Use it for course videos, training videos, digital human lectures, lesson talking head series, elearning video, teacher avatar video, lecture video maker work, and training presenter video.
